narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On November 21, 2024, at approximately 0445 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stopped a pickup truck with two occupants on US-23 near Dundee, Michigan, after a sheriff's deputy requested help with identification. Both occupants stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents. This record concerns one of the two occupants; the other is documented separately.
ENTRY:
The driver stated that he walked across the border near Lukeville, Arizona, in 2015.
The passenger stated that he does not remember when he came.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Both occupants were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station.
